description: This source file defines the CredentialTypeResolver class, which is responsible for resolving credential types based on object instances and type identifiers. It handles types such as Password, PSK, and X509 Certificates, integrating with Jackson's type resolution mechanisms.

classes.name: CredentialTypeResolver
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of credential types, mapping credential objects to specific type identifiers and vice versa.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with the base JavaType for deserialization.

methods.name: getMechanism
methods.description: Returns the mechanism type used by this resolver, which is 'NAME'.

methods.name: idFromValue
methods.description: Determines the type id string from a given credential object.

methods.name: idFromValueAndType
methods.description: Determines the type id string based on the object and explicitly provided class, identifying specific credential types.

methods.name: typeFromId
methods.description: Resolves the JavaType for a credential based on the type id string.
